Introduction

DATA Wrangling

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)

# Import original data
listings <- read.csv("https://ajohns24.github.io/data/NYC_airbnb_kaggle.csv")
nbhd     <- read.csv("https://ajohns24.github.io/data/NYC_nbhd_kaggle.csv")

# Wrangle this into the final airbnb data
set.seed(253)
airbnb <- listings %>% 
  filter(price > 0, price < 1000) %>% 
  sample_n(size = 5000) %>% 
  rename(neighbourhood = neighbourhood_cleansed) %>% 
  left_join(nbhd) %>% 
  select(-neighbourhood, -amenities, -host_response_rate, -calendar_updated)
# Create wrangling recipe
airbnb_recipe <- recipe(price ~ ., data = airbnb) %>% 
  step_rm(
    latitude, longitude, host_response_time, host_is_superhost, 
    host_has_profile_pic, is_location_exact, review_scores_rating, 
    cancellation_policy, require_guest_profile_picture, reviews_per_month
  ) %>% 
  step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) %>%
  step_impute_knn(all_predictors(), neighbors = 5) 
# Train the recipe on the data and view head
airbnb_baked <- airbnb_recipe %>% 
  prep() %>% 
  bake(new_data = NULL)

Plots

# Plot 1: Predictors used (2): accommodation capacity, roomtype
ggplot(airbnb_baked, aes(x = accommodates, y = price, color = room_type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, position = "jitter") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Price Trends by Physical Capacity and Room Type",
    x = "Number of Guests Accommodated",
    y = "Nightly Price ($)",
    color = "Room Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
# Plot 2: Price Distributions Across Neighborhood Groups (Boroughs)
ggplot(airbnb_baked, aes(x = neighbourhood_group, y = price, fill = neighbourhood_group)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7, outlier.alpha = 0.2) +
  labs(
    title = "AirBnB Price Distributions Across NYC Boroughs",
    x = "Borough",
    y = "Nightly Price ($)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
# Plot 3: Interactions Between Capacity, Location, and Price Predictors used (2): accommodation capacity, neighborhood location
ggplot(airbnb_baked, aes(x = accommodates, y = price)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 1) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", color = "blue", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ neighbourhood_group) +
  labs(
    title = "Price Scaling by Capacity Faceted by Borough",
    x = "Number of Guests Accommodated",
    y = "Nightly Price ($)"
  ) +
  theme_light()
# Plot 4: Predictors used (3): property_type, bedrooms, beds
ggplot(airbnb_baked, aes(x = bedrooms, y = price, color = property_type)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = beds), alpha = 0.5, position = position_jitter(width = 0.15, height = 0)) +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Price Trends by Bedrooms, Beds, and Property Type",
    subtitle = "Size counts scaling across spatial structural layouts",
    x = "Number of Bedrooms",
    y = "Nightly Price ($)",
    color = "Property Type",
    size = "Number of Beds"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
# Plot 5: Predictors used (3): guests_included, number_of_reviews, bed_type
ggplot(airbnb_baked, aes(x = guests_included, y = price)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = number_of_reviews), alpha = 0.4, color = "darkgreen") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "darkred", se = FALSE) +
  facet_wrap(~ bed_type) +
  labs(
    title = "Price Tractions Faceted by Sleeping Configurations",
    subtitle = "Predictors: Guests Included, Number of Reviews, and Bed Type",
    x = "Guests Included in Base Price",
    y = "Nightly Price ($)",
    size = "Total Review Volume"
  ) +
  theme_light()
# Plot 6:Predictors used (3): minimum_nights, availability_30, instant_bookable
ggplot(airbnb_baked, aes(x = availability_30, y = price, color = instant_bookable)) +
  geom_point(aes(size = minimum_nights), alpha = 0.4, position = "jitter") +
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = FALSE, size = 1.2) +
  labs(
    title = "Plot 3: Booking Strategies & Operational Vacancies",
    subtitle = "Predictors: 30-Day Availability, Instant Bookable, and Minimum Nights",
    x = "Vacancy Rate (Days Available Out of Next 30)",
    y = "Nightly Price ($)",
    color = "Instant Bookable Status",
    size = "Minimum Nights Requirement"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

library(tidyverse)
library(tidymodels)

set.seed(253)

# This removes columns with zero variance to keep the LASSO math engine stable
airbnb_recipe_model <- recipe(price ~ ., data = airbnb) %>% 
  step_rm(id) %>% 
  step_string2factor(all_nominal_predictors()) %>% 
  step_dummy(all_nominal_predictors()) %>% 
  step_zv(all_predictors()) %>% 
  step_impute_knn(all_predictors(), neighbors = 5)


# Cross Validation Folds
airbnb_folds <- vfold_cv(airbnb, v = 10)
# LS regression model
lm_spec <- linear_reg() %>% 
  set_engine("lm") %>% 
  set_mode("regression")

lm_workflow <- workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(airbnb_recipe_model) %>% 
  add_model(lm_spec)

lm_cv_results <- fit_resamples(
  lm_workflow,
  resamples = airbnb_folds,
  metrics = metric_set(mae, rmse, rsq)
)

print("LS metrics")
## [1] "LS metrics"
print(collect_metrics(lm_cv_results))
## # A tibble: 3 × 6
##   .metric .estimator   mean     n std_err .config        
##   <chr>   <chr>       <dbl> <int>   <dbl> <chr>          
## 1 mae     standard   47.3      10  0.426  pre0_mod0_post0
## 2 rmse    standard   74.9      10  1.21   pre0_mod0_post0
## 3 rsq     standard    0.540    10  0.0155 pre0_mod0_post0
# Penalized lasso regression
lasso_spec <- linear_reg(penalty = tune(), mixture = 1) %>% 
  set_engine("glmnet") %>% 
  set_mode("regression")

lasso_workflow <- workflow() %>% 
  add_recipe(airbnb_recipe_model) %>% 
  add_model(lasso_spec)

lasso_grid <- grid_regular(penalty(range = c(-3, 1)), levels = 50)

lasso_tune_results <- tune_grid(
  lasso_workflow,
  resamples = airbnb_folds,
  grid = lasso_grid,
  metrics = metric_set(mae, rmse)
)


print("LASSO metrics")
## [1] "LASSO metrics"
print(show_best(lasso_tune_results, metric = "mae", n = 5))
## # A tibble: 5 × 7
##   penalty .metric .estimator  mean     n std_err .config         
##     <dbl> <chr>   <chr>      <dbl> <int>   <dbl> <chr>           
## 1    2.22 mae     standard    46.5    10   0.401 pre0_mod42_post0
## 2    1.84 mae     standard    46.5    10   0.403 pre0_mod41_post0
## 3    1.53 mae     standard    46.5    10   0.403 pre0_mod40_post0
## 4    2.68 mae     standard    46.5    10   0.402 pre0_mod43_post0
## 5    1.26 mae     standard    46.6    10   0.405 pre0_mod39_post0
# To see which predictors remain
best_lasso_fit <- lasso_workflow %>% 
  finalize_workflow(select_best(lasso_tune_results, metric = "mae")) %>% 
  fit(data = airbnb)

best_lasso_fit %>% 
  extract_fit_engine() %>% 
  tidy() %>% 
  filter(step == max(step))
